portugal.title: Flag of Portugal

colors.note: Represents hope; occupies 2/5 of the hoist side
Represents the revolution; occupies 3/5 of the fly side

desc: - A vertical division with green at the hoist and red at the fly, overlaid with the national coat of arms including an armillary sphere
- Adopted following the 1910 revolution that established the Portuguese Republic
trivia:
- The shield shows the five lesser shields representing five victories and the cross (Christianity)
- The red stripe represents the cost in blood of Portuguese discoveries and independence
- Portugal's flag was adopted in 1910 during the Portuguese Republic revolution
